thread:
sam_support: FYI customer (mobile-app team) reporting 5xx/timeouts on hosted API after a promo. lots of failures at ~2:45pm UTC. P95 blown up. Can SRE take a look? :rotating_light:

alex_eng_sre: on it. any customer repro or request IDs?

sam_support: customer provided a few req_ids: req-20260317-01, req-20260317-02. they said spike ~800rps for ~30s then tail timeouts.

maria_prod: saw alerts — gateway p50->p99 gap. dashboards show request_queue_depth climbed and batcher backlog. linking trace: https://internal.redwood/traces/abc123

alex_eng_sre: pulling logs now. quick grep shows many queued requests stuck in continuous-batcher pending state. queue_depth peaked at 1200, configured limit 1024. some requests timed out at gateway after hitting deadline.

jin_oncall: timeline: ingress spike -> batcher window stayed normal -> queue depth exceeded soft limit -> continuous batching created long queue backlog -> p99 token generation stalled -> gateway returned 504s after deadline.

alex_eng_sre: snippet from batcher debug: ```
BATCHER DEBUG: ts=2026-03-17T14:45:12Z pending=1189 window_ms=10 batchers=8 kv_cache_size=0
EVICT: none pending_evictions=0 queue_limit=1024
```

alex_eng_sre: suspect two things: queue depth limit + batching policy not shedding fast enough. continuous batcher keeps accumulating prefixes and waiting for batch fills. under heavy ingress this causes tail latency.

sam_support: customer wants immediate mitigation. they see 30s+ timeouts. what quick fixes can we do?

maria_prod: options: 1) temporarily throttle their API key (rate-limit) 2) bump queue_limit on hosted gateway (risky global) 3) reduce batcher window / disable continuous batching for that tenant route 4) fail-fast early for >X queue position.

jin_oncall: do #3 per-tenant if possible. we have per-tenant routing flags that can disable continuous batching or force micro-batches.

alex_eng_sre: I can push a routing override to mark their tenant as "prefer_low_latency" which sets batch_window=1ms and max_queue_depth=256 for that tenant. will also route to extra burst pool.

sam_support: customer approves mitigation. please proceed.

deploy-bot: triggered run: route-override apply tenant=mobile-app profile=prefer_low_latency by=alex_eng_sre

ops-bot: scaled up burst-pool for tenant=mobile-app +2 machines (g4dn.xlarge equivalent)

alex_eng_sre: mitigation applied. monitoring shows request_queue_depth dropping from 1189 -> 210 within 45s. p99 latency down from 32s -> 750ms. errors dropping.

sam_support: passing update to customer, they confirm fewer errors. they ask for root cause and long-term fix.

maria_prod: root cause summary for support note: ingress spike + continuous-batching semantics allowed queue to grow past configured soft limit; queue limit enforcement delayed because of pending KV cache state and no early-fail policy; combined with gateway deadline semantics produced tail timeouts. will include repro steps and runbook.

alex_eng_sre: repro steps I used: 
1) send 900-1000 parallel short text completions with inter-arrival jitter 0-5ms using same tenant key.
2) ensure model variant uses normal continuous batching config.
3) observe pending>1000 and p99 errors at gateway after deadline.

alex_eng_sre: sample curl used: ```bash
for i in {1..1000}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TENANT_KEY" -d '{"input":"test","max_tokens":4}' &
done
wait
```

jin_oncall: proposed long-term fixes: add early-fail for queue_position>threshold, tighten queue_limit enforcement path, improve continuous-batcher shedding (prefer micro-batches or immediate dispatch when queue depth high), and alert when queue depth approaches 80% with automatic routing to burst pools.

maria_prod: I'll draft a customer-friendly postmortem and ops runbook. action items: Alex will open infra ticket to implement per-tenant micro-batch flag + quick path; Jin will spec early-fail + alerting; Product to review default batching policy for promo/flash sale traffic patterns.

alex_eng_sre: creating infra ticket now: INFRA-6248 "per-tenant low-latency batch flag and fast-path"

jin_oncall: creating SRE ticket: SRE-3310 "queue early-fail and alerting for continuous-batcher"

sam_support: thanks team. keeping thread open until we have tickets and customer postmortem. :thumbsup:
